key_insight: A plug-and-play concept bottleneck framework can debug medical imaging models by testing and intervening on specific concepts rather than treating the model as a black box.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help clinicians and researchers identify misleading shortcuts in imaging AI and refine models in a more interpretable, targeted way.
method: Align a single-modality encoder to BioMedCLIP to build a concept bottleneck model.
Intervene at the concept level to separate causal from spuriously correlated features.
Use counterfactual samples and expert review to guide targeted fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on a Mayo Clinic ultrasound dataset and the CheXpert 5x200 chest X-ray dataset, with results showing reliable model diagnosis and occasional performance gains after guided fine-tuning.
watch_item: Concept interventions depend on high-quality concept definitions and expert validation, so results may not transfer cleanly if concepts are incomplete or noisy.
paper_title: Beyond Explanation: Debugging Medical Imaging Models via Concept Intervention
